interpreted_intent: A photographic realization of the requested subject, place and visible state.
subject: A rocky coast
visual_priorities: The frame gives the coast and its fog layers priority across the wide scene
baseline_prompt_en: A rocky coast at dawn lies beneath low fog. A broad photographic view shows wet rocks entering the sea and pale warm light along the horizon. The fog lies close to the water and leaves the nearer rock edges distinct. Soft horizon light separates shallow pools from dark rock faces while distant water fades into haze. The frame gives the coast and its fog layers priority across the wide scene.
